objective: Implement and verify a controlled Main-local raw PDD ingress that binds to live session/document evidence, handles incomplete identity explicitly, maps through the existing canonical contracts, validates against the real InboundEnvelope schema, collects or stops without fallback, and performs no AI, transport send, or persistence side effects.

source_dist_relationship.source_to_dist: Fresh builds were run in this task before focused and suite tests; tests imported the resulting dist artifacts. No old dist result was used as substitute.
source_dist_relationship.canonical_validation: Main ingress uses the real canonical validatorFor('fastwork:domain:inbound-envelope') by default; tests also inject unavailable, false, and throwing validator branches.

tests.command: pnpm --filter @fastwork/domain build; pnpm --filter @fastwork/platform-pdd build; pnpm --filter @fastwork/desktop build

zero_side_effect_evidence.evidence: Smoke instruments the fixture transport adapter, legacy inbound callback, and orchestrator AI callback. The selected path does not call PddOrchestratorBridge, ConversationOrchestrator, AI, transport send, or persistence; the service has no persistence port in this unit.

mock_boundaries.fake_view: The test/smoke FakeView supplies WebContents identity and liveness only.
mock_boundaries.real_components: PddPlatformService, PddSessionHost, raw PDD normalization, canonical mapper, and real schema validator run as actual implementation.
mock_boundaries.not_claimed: No Electron IPC, renderer preload, real PDD, Titan, WebSocket, database, or production bootstrap integration is claimed.

remaining_real_producer_gap.description: The bounded unit uses controlled Main-local raw PDD payload fixtures. A future real PDD/Titan/WebSocket producer must receive a separate integration review and must connect through the same trusted Main ingress rather than the legacy DOM message_received -> AI bridge.

known_limitations: Source time accepts a strict ISO-8601 UTC Z subset; offsets and unverified platform time semantics are treated as invalid/unknown.
No production IPC channel is registered for the new ingress.
No durable dedupe or persistence is implemented.
No real PDD or Electron IPC integration is claimed.
The legacy DOM dedup path remains unmodified and is not repaired by this unit.
